nodes.label: Perfect Moment Street Photo (Palm Ave)
nodes.description: A decorative photograph, not a diagram or technical artifact: a sunny street corner looking up through the leafy canopy of a large tree toward a blue sky, with a 'Palm' street sign, a traffic light, a no-right-turn sign, and a multi-story mixed-use building with storefronts (including a bank) in the background — likely a Southern California intersection. The filename 'perfect_moment' suggests it captures a personal, serendipitous moment and serves as ambient/decorative content in the docs rather than illustrating any pkcore code or concept.
